idle.action: subtle breathing or hovering bob, one blink or tiny antenna/robe movement; keep a clear stable silhouette

walk.action: six readable locomotion poses appropriate to this creature, visible alternating limb or hover motion; preserve identity and avoid blur

attack.action: six readable attack poses from ready through one controlled strike and complete recovery to the starting pose; preserve identity

style: Match the attached base image in identity, view, outline, palette and material. Keep every pose centered with the full silhouette.
